userId.description: TinyDB user UUID for the authenticated operator.

requestId.description: Correlation id spanning UI and API work for a single operation.

properties.description: Event payload limited to the event allowlist.

events.description: Authenticated operator opened the outbound assignment flow for an Asset.
events.hypothesis: Assignment lead time starts before the AssignmentOrder is submitted, and friction may occur before API submission.
events.business_decision: Decide whether outbound workflow UX or training is delaying onboarding asset delivery.
events.pii_strategy: Use UUIDs only for created_by and assigned_to_candidate when present; do not capture names or emails.

properties.name: asset_id
properties.description: Selected Asset id if known when the flow starts.

properties.name: office
properties.description: Canonical office value: valencia or miami.

properties.name: flow_origin
properties.description: Where the operator entered the flow from, such as asset_list or order_history.

events.description: AssignmentOrder creation failed because validation or stock rules blocked completion.
events.hypothesis: Failed AssignmentOrders reveal whether onboarding delays are caused by insufficient stock or invalid inputs.
events.business_decision: Decide whether to change stock policy, operator training, or form validation UX.
events.pii_strategy: Use UUIDs only; record normalized failure_reason codes rather than raw input or exception bodies.

properties.name: failure_reason
properties.description: Normalized reason code such as insufficient_stock or missing_assigned_to.

properties.name: assigned_to
properties.description: Opaque employee UUID when the assignment target was supplied.

events.description: AssignmentOrder was successfully created and stock was reduced through the supported workflow.
events.hypothesis: Successful AssignmentOrders complete the lead-time measurement for onboarding asset delivery.
events.business_decision: Decide which offices and asset categories need process changes to reduce assignment lead time.
events.pii_strategy: Use UUIDs only for assigned_to and created_by. No names or emails.

properties.name: lead_time_seconds
properties.description: Elapsed time from assignment_flow_started to order creation when correlation exists.

properties.name: audit_required
properties.description: True for software_licence assignments requiring a durable audit trail.

events.description: Asset stock reached or fell below its minimum threshold after a successful AssignmentOrder.
events.hypothesis: Threshold breaches are an early warning before zero-stock events and should drive procurement action.
events.business_decision: Decide whether procurement cadence or reorder points must change for a specific office or category.

properties.name: current_stock
properties.description: Available stock after the stock-changing operation.

properties.name: min_stock_threshold
properties.description: Configured minimum threshold for the Asset.

properties.name: trigger_source_event
properties.description: Source event that caused the threshold breach, usually assignment_order_created.

properties.name: trigger_source_order_id
properties.description: Identifier of the order that caused the threshold breach.

events.description: ProcurementOrder creation failed because validation or service rules blocked it.
events.hypothesis: Failed ProcurementOrders reveal why replenishment work is delayed before stock is restored.
events.business_decision: Decide whether procurement friction is caused by data quality, vendor setup, or operator workflow.
events.pii_strategy: Use created_by UUID only. Do not include vendor contacts or raw request payloads.

properties.name: vendor
properties.description: Vendor name only when explicitly accepted by the event allowlist.

properties.name: failure_reason
properties.description: Normalized reason code such as invalid_quantity or unknown_vendor.

events.description: ProcurementOrder was successfully created for an Asset.
events.hypothesis: Consecutive ProcurementOrder events for the same Asset reveal whether procurement is reactive or proactive.
events.business_decision: Decide whether reorder points and procurement cadence should be adjusted by office and category.
events.pii_strategy: Use created_by UUID only. Capture vendor name only, not contact details or free-form notes.

events.description: A direct request to edit Asset stock outside ProcurementOrder or AssignmentOrder was blocked.
events.hypothesis: Rejected direct stock edits show where operators try to bypass the inventory integrity model.
events.business_decision: Decide whether to improve permissions, training, or stock-management UX.
events.pii_strategy: Use operator UUID only. Do not capture raw request payloads.

events.description: Assignment flow started but no AssignmentOrder was completed before inactivity or exit.
events.hypothesis: Abandoned assignment flows indicate friction before order submission.
events.business_decision: Decide whether the outbound workflow needs simpler defaults, validation guidance, or session handling changes.
events.pii_strategy: Use UUIDs only. No raw form snapshots.

properties.name: asset_id
properties.description: Selected Asset id if one had been chosen.

properties.name: elapsed_seconds
properties.description: Time spent in the flow before abandonment.

properties.name: last_step
properties.description: Last meaningful step reached, such as asset_selected or submit_attempted.

events.description: Operator opened the Asset list view.
events.hypothesis: The Asset list is the main operational entry point and should be segmented by office.
events.business_decision: Decide how operators enter inventory workflows and whether office-specific workflows dominate.

properties.name: office
properties.description: Office filter value at first view if one is applied.

properties.name: result_count
properties.description: Number of Assets visible to the operator.

properties.name: view_source
properties.description: Entry source such as nav_menu or redirect_after_login.
